surface: Full pinned Drei web API parity in progress; support is declared only by the executable crosswalk.

divergences.behavior: Inline Canvas views are ported. Calling View from an Octane DOM root fails with the universal renderer-boundary diagnostic, and View.Port is a callable no-op.
divergences.reason: Octane components are statically renderer-owned, so one component cannot switch between DOM and Three renderers or transport authored Three children between independent roots as React Drei does with tunnel-rat.

ssr: Browser-dependent helpers remain client-only; server-safe behavior is verified per export.
